body:
Incoming main 090797e333748b1a62db0a857d8d0f0e40b524fe adds a second identical Azure.Security.KeyVault.Keys/4.10.2 catalog entry, so the unchanged central validator refuses the catalog. Remove only that new duplicate. The approved single KeyVault.Keys 4.10.2 and Azure.Core 1.64.0 entries remain.

The corrected complete tree is exactly reviewed e07ac76e9b2a6c0ef34c02507bea054d25e48be5 (tree 24590fcf5888ba622a93c4a44ef5a7292ce51736), retaining the merged direct-catalog runtime correction and every other binding. No version, audit policy or audit data changes.

Validation: all six unchanged owning controls pass: central package validation (316 entries), authoritative catalog tests, central validator tests, package audit validation, audit generator tests and audit validator tests. The initial duplicate refusal is retained. Exact commit/title passes locked commitlint 21.2.4 under Node 24.22.1/npm 11.19.1. Local controls ran once against the identical corrected tree in a frozen 090 checkout to preserve their captured revision while the PR commit was prepared separately.

Normal current-head CI/review and parent publication coordination remain required. No merge, publication, accepted pin or lifecycle change is included.
title: fix(build): remove the duplicate KeyVault pin
head: fix/keyvault-catalog-uniqueness
display_title: fix(build): remove the duplicate KeyVault pin
